content: Verified on developer.apple.com 2026-10-08: Xcode 27 released 2026-09-14 (27.1 RC 10-05), iOS 27.0.1, Swift 6.4 (2026-09-15). App Store uploads require Xcode 26/iOS 26 SDK since 2026-04-28; min deployment target iOS 13 since 2026-09-09. iOS 26 on 79% of all devices (86% of last-4-year devices) as of 2026-06-07. iOS 27 supports iPhone 11+ (same as 26). Liquid Glass opt-out ignored under iOS 27 SDK.
